newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PORTUGAL ENTREPRENEUR TO BUY SPADEL UNIT.
newsitem.headline: PORTUGAL ENTREPRENEUR TO BUY SPADEL UNIT.

text.p: Portuguese entrepreneur Jose Sousa Cintra said he was buying Portuguese mineral water company Empresa das Aguas do Alardo from Belgium's Spadel group.
Sousa Cintra told Reuters by telephone that he was buying Alardo, which is filing for bankruptcy, but he gave no details of the acquisition.
Spadel, which has had difficulty selling Alardo, announced earlier today that it had found a buyer.

The Portuguese company was closed down on March 10 when its bottled water was found to contain traces of algae. Production and sales restarted on March 20 after further tests revealed the water was safe for consumption.
Sousa Cintra sold another Portuguese mineral water company, Vidago, Melgaco e Pedras Salgadas, to retail group Jeronimo Martins for 15.5 billion escudos earlier this year.
